_note: V3 R1 (P8b): the durability policy of each gateway's tick spool, per sidecar side (heartbeat side names: cpp_exec = the live gateway cpp-acct, cpp_exec_demo = the demo gateway cpp-exec). It is an owner input, read by services/tick-segment-manifest.js to judge a restart: DURABLE means a restart must not lose a sealed segment, so any segment gone at a restart reads persistence FAILED; EPHEMERAL_LOSS_RECORDED means the spool is not kept across a restart and each loss is recorded instead (T1 grades that as a pass). An entry applies from its `from` (ISO UTC); an entry whose `from` is null is declared but not yet in force. A restart is judged by the boot BEFORE it: it counts under an entry when Node last listed the previous boot at or after that entry's `from`, so the spool a restart loses is judged under the policy that governed it. A side with no entry in force reads persistence NOT_VERIFIABLE. This file changes a verdict, never a trade, a limit or a gateway.
